tool.name: evaluate_ludb_cse.py
tool.gate_role: Guard CSE-style interval measurement behaviour while modules move (doc 05 B: Phases 1 and 3).

datasets.name: LUDB
datasets.subset_rule: All 200 LUDB records (numeric order), passed explicitly via --records. The tool reads LUDB from the fixed path <tool dir>/data/lobachevsky-...-1.0.1/data.

record_schema_note: legacy ecgfeat export (pre-ECG-Record); no record schema is exercised by these tools at this revision

determinism.ungated_note: runtime/wall-clock values; environment-dependent, not gated, not a result difference
